title: announce_store read/write leaves unzeroized sealing-seed copies on the stack
description: Found by security review of project-LICHEN-worker6-dowx (pre-existing in child-1 code, but now on the announce admission hot path). AnnounceTrustStore::read and write (announce_store.rs:200-201, 220-221) call derive_keypair(&Seed::new(*seed)) which copies the node persistence key material onto the stack on EVERY record read, not just writes. The durable copy is correctly Zeroizing and Debug is redacted, but each pinned_pubkey_for durable fallback and each admission check leaves a transient non-zeroized seed copy in stack memory. Hygiene inconsistency with the crate's own Zeroizing discipline; low exposure window, no logging path. Fix: keep a pre-derived keypair in the store at construction, or zeroize the transient copies.
